# datadog_status_page_maintenance_templates (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the maintenance templates of a Datadog status page, for discovery or import. An empty result is not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datadog_status_page_maintenance_templates" "all" {
  page_id = "5e9bd12c-6cde-4247-85fd-98045fbd9b8f"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String) The ID of the status page whose maintenance templates to list.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter the results to templates with this exact name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `maintenance_templates` (List of Object) The list of matching maintenance templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_templates`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `maintenance_title` (String)
- `name` (String)
